description: Twarangije igitabo c'icete c'Abaheburayo, muri ico gitabo twarigishijwe ibitari bike kandi vyahimbaye imitima yacu.
name: Abakristo n'abantu badasanzwe

description: Twihweje ingene ahera hambere hari ikigereranyo c'ahera mw'ijuru. Twabonye kandi kuvy'ubuherezi bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo ahari mw'ijuru. Ihema ryatangigwamwo ibimazi ryari ryubatswe hakurikijwe ikigereranyo c'iryo mw'ijuru nk'uko Imana yavyeretse Mose. Ihema ryari rigabuwemwo ibice bibiri, hari iryo hino ryitwa ahera hakaba n'iryo hirya y'igihuzu gikinze ryitwa ahera cane (Hebr. 9: 2-3, Hebr. 9:3-5, Hebr.9:7) Imana ishimwe ko yaduhaye umwana wayo w'ikinege atagira icaha kugira ngo atubere umucunguzi n'umuherezi mukuru. Niwe muherezi mukuru w'igitangaza adakeneye kubanza kwitangirira ibimazi, amaraso yiwe yatanze ni kubw'abana ba bantu.
name: Ahera ha mbere cari ikigereranyo c'ahera ho mw'ijuru

description: kurengana, kwigira imbere, ukwihana
name: Akaga ko guheba Imana

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'agaciro ntangere k'amaraso y' Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo. Twaribukanije n'ingene ahera hambere hari ikigereranyo c'ahera ho mw'ijuru. Abaherezi bo mw'isi bama na ntaryo binjira mw'ihema ryo hino kugira ngo batangire ab'Isirayeli ibimazi, mw'ihema rya kabiri naho hinjirayo umuherezi mukuru gusa kandi akinjirayo rimwe gusa mu mwaka. Umwami Yesu ari we muherezi wacu mukuru wewe n'agaheta, amaze gupfa, igihuzu cari gikingiriye ahera catantamutsemwo kubiri bisobanurwa ngo abizera bose bahawe uburenganzira bwo kwishikira imbere y'Imana . Twibuke ko Kristo atigeze yinjira mw'ihema ryo mw'isi kuduhererezayo ibimazi, n'umuherezi mukuru w'agakiza kandi w'agakura akorera mw'ihema ry'ukuri ryo mw'ijuru. (Hebr 9:11)
name: Akamaro k'amaraso ya Kristo

description: igikorwa, kugwa, ubuhungiro, igihuzu
name: Amasezerano Y'Imana atera ivyizigiro

description: Twumvise impanuro zijanye n'ugushira imitima kw'ijambo ry'Imana no kuyubaha tugakora ibiyihimbara. Twarihweje kandi ivyanditswe mu ntango g'igice ca 13 c'icete candikiwe Abaheburayo ku vyo gukunda bene data , kwubaha umubano w'ababiranye n'ukwirinda ngo ntitube inkunzi z'amahera. Twarangirije kw'ijambo ryo muri ico gice c'Abaheburayo 13:8 rivuga ngo: " Yesu Kristo uko yari ejo n'uno musi niko ari,niko azokwama ibihe bidashira".iryo zina ngo Yesu Kristo twaribukijwe yuko ririmwo amazina abiri, Yesu n'izina ryerekana ukuba umuntu kwiwe, Kristo naryo ni Mesiya izina yamye kuva na kera nari ndi, n'izina rero ryerekana ubumana bwiwe. Uko yamye ari Imana kandi akaba nyene ububasha, akaba nyen'imbabazi n'urukundo n'uyu musi ntarahinduka kandi ntazokwigera ahinduka.
name: Gushira umutima kw'ijambo ry'Imana

description: Ubuheruka twumvise ivy'ububasha buhambaye bw'Umwami Yesu kandi tukabona n'ukugene aruta Mose. Twarumvise yuko Umwami Yesu ariwe muherezi mukuru yatwitangiye ko ikimazi c'ivyaha vyacu. Akaga ni ku bantu banka kumwizera kandi birigwa barumva ivy'inkomezi yakoze, abo rero baba banse kwinjira mu buruhukiro bw'imitima . Ukutizera nikwo kwatumye Imana igirira umwikomo ab' Isirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa ikabamarira mu bugaragwa ntibashike mu gihugu c'isezerano. Bamaze kurengana umusozi Sinayi , bagiye gutuma abatasi ngo baje gutata igihugu Imana yabasezeraniye babura kuyizera no kubandanya urugendo nk'uko yari yabategetse . Abatasi batumweyo Imana yarabaretse bashikiriza bagenzi babo inkuru z'agacavutu zivuga yuko badakwiye gupfa kwisukira mu gihugu c'isezerano kuko hariyo ibigabo vy'ibigatanya vyohava bibabera intambamyi. Urwo ruganwe rero rwose Imana yaciye iruzingira muri ubwo bugaragwa ruhonerayo nayo mu gihugu c'isezerano hashikayo abana n'abuzukuru babo. Ukutizera rero kw'ab'Isirayeli kwababereye inkwezi y'amarere.
name: Ico Imana igomba ku bantu bayo bumva ijambo ryayo

description: Twihweje ingene ikimazi Kristo yatanze kiruta ibimazi vyatangwa mw'isezerano rya kera. Iki cete candikiwe Abaheburayo canditswe mu gihe isezerano rya kera ryariko rirahera ngo hatangure ivy'isezerano risha. Nico gituma twabonye amajambo y'umwami Yesu muri kino gice ca 10:9 avuga ngo" Aherako aravuga atehe nzanywe no gukora ivyo ugomba, akuraho ivyambere ngo ashinge ivya kabiri" Twarumvise yuko ibimazi vya kera vyatangwa kenshi kuko bitashobora gukuraho ivyaha. Ikimazi catanzwe n'Umwami Yesu aho yapfa k'umusalaba nico cabaye igikuraho ivyaha. Umwami Yesu rero yaje gushitsa ukugomba kw'Imana (Abaheburayo 10:9-10)
name: Ikimazi Kristo yatanze kiruta ibimazi vyose vya Mose

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'ukwiyubara inyigisho zitandukanye zitesha umwanya wubusa kandi zizimiza. Inyigisho z'ukuri n'iz'ijambo ry'Imana rituyoborera ku kwizera Umwami Yesu Kristo ,umwana w'Imana nzima ,uwo niwe mukiza akura ivyaha vy'abari mw'isi bose . Nico gituma ijambo ry'Imana rivuga ngo :"Ariko abamwakiriye bose yabahaye ububasha bwo gucika abana b'Imana, izina ryiwe ni Yesu Kristo, Imana yigize umuntu, Kristo niryo zina ry'ubumana bwiwe Yesu naryo niryo zina yiswe igihe yaza mw'isi, ariko ubundi Yesu Kristo nawe n' uw'Uhoraho kandi yamye ari umunyabushobozi nk'uko twabibonye mu (Abaheburayo 13:8) Yesu Kristo rero yaje mw'isi azanywe no kudukiza ngo adukure mu vyaha. Amaze kuza agapfa kubw'ivyaha vyacu ntivyari bigikenewe yuko abantu basubira kuja mu rusengero kubandanya batanga ibimazi vy'ivyaha , yaratwitangiye aba ikimazikizima c'intasubirwamwo aho yapfira ku musaraba. uyu musi rero avyagiye mw'ijuru imbere iburyo bwa Data wa twese niwe muherezi mukuru aduserukira imbere y'Imana.
name: Impanuro zidufasha kurushiriza kwubaha Imana

description: Twumvise impanuro zitari nke zerekeye kutava mu buntu bw'Imana. Uwandikiye Abaheburayo, yarabibukije ko bakwiye kwizigama kugira ngo ntihagire numwe adashikira ubuntu bw'Imana.Twaribukijwe kandi muri ico cete nyene igice ca 12:6-7 ingene Esawu yanjanjwe kuvyo kuba samuragwa kwiwe ariko munyuma akabirondera akabibura. Twaraganiriye kandi kuvy'Isiyoni wo mw'isi n'Isiyoni wo mw'ijuru. Isiyoni wo mw'isi ni Yerusalemu ku murwa wa Dawidi ah'Abisirayeli bahorabakoranira kuva na kera basomerwa ivyagezwe vya Mose kandi bahereza ibimazi nkuko vyari bitegekanijwe mw'idini ry'Abayuda aho nyene Isiyoni h'I Yerusalemu. Isiyoni ho mw'ijuru ariho Yerusalemu nsha naho abizera Umwami Yesu bose bazoja bakabana nawe ibihe bitazoshira.
name: impanuro zo kwumvira ijambo ry'Imana

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene Kisto aruta Mose twishimikije muvyanditswe mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo 3:1-6. Twarumvise ubwambere yuko Kristo ari umwana w'Imana nayo Mose akaba umushumba wayo . Kristo n'umuremyi ariko Mose akaba icaremwe. Abo bompi uko ari 2 vyanditswe ko bayobokeye Imana kandi bakaba mu rugo rwayo ariko bari batandukanye, twibuke amajambo yanditswe muri iki gice ca 3:6 . Abizera ijambo ry'Imana bakakira Umwami Yesu mu bugingo bwabo basangiye ihamagagwa riva mw'ijuru, abo nibo babangirije ubushizi bw'amamanga no kwirata ivyizigiro vyabo abo nibo kandi bitwa abo mu rugo rw'Imana.
name: Ingene Kristo aruta Mose

description: Twaganiriye ku ngorane zo kuba intumva zituma abakristo badatahura neza ijambo ry'Imana . Twarabonye kandi ingene ar'akaga kudakura muvyo kumenya Imana.
name: Ingene Kristo yatubereye umuherezi mukuru

description: Twihweje ivy'ubuherezi bwa Kristo nk'uko tubibona mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo igice c'I 7. Twarangije twihweza ingene ubuherezi bw'uwo Kristo buruta ubw' Abayuda.
name: Ingene Melekisedeki ari umuherezi ahambaye

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene ukutizera kwabereye Ab'Isirayeli inkwezi y'amarere. Imana yababajwe n'ukubona ingene bagiye bayigabagabira bakanka kwumvira ivy'ibagera vyose kandi nayo yarabakunda. Twasanze ukutizera arikwo kwatumye abari bavuye muri Egiputa barongowe na Mose batashitse mu gihugu c'I Kanani bari barasezeraniwe n'Imana. Turibuka ingene bari baracumukuriye muri Egiputa aho bari abaja maze Imana ikabakuzayo ukuboko kwayo kw'inkomezi ngo baje I Kanani aho yari yabateguriye igihugu c'uburuhukiro ariko twarabonye akaga ko kutizera dusomnye muri iki cete ca 3 :18-19.
name: Ingorane zashikiye Ab'Isirayeli kubera kutumvira Imana

description: Twihweje intangamarara ijanye n'icete candikiwe Abaheburayo. Muri iyo ntangamarara rero, twarumvise ko ico cete c'Abaheburayo ari igitabo kivugwamwo cane ivy'icubahiro ca Kristo kirenze ic'abandi bose .Twarangirije kw'ijambo ryiza ritubwira ko Kristo ariwe dukwiye gushirako imitima .
name: intangamarara

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene isezerano risha riruta irya kera. Ivyo tubibona mu gitabo candikiwe Abaheburayo 8:7-13, mu ncamake rero twarumvise yuko isezerano rya kera rishimikiye ku vyagezwe vya Mose ryarimwo agahaze, ntiryatuma abantu bakizwa ngo bave mu caha ahubwo baguma barenga ivyasezeranywe canke ivyagezwe bagaca babandanya gutangigwa ibimazi kugira ngo ivyo vyaha vyabo bitwikirwe, nico catumye rero Imana ishiraho isezerano risha rishimikiye ku gakiza kabonerwa muri Kristo Yesu. Si uko isezerano rya kera ryari ribi ariko ryarimwo agahaze, ariko ryarimwo agasoro, irishasha ryo rituma abantu bakizwa bakaba abana b'Imana kubwo kwakira Umwami Yesu Kristo mu bugingo bwabo akaba umwami n'umukiza w'ubugingo bafise.
name: Isezerano risha riruta irya kera

description: Twarabonye ko ijambo ngenderwako ryo mu gice ca 11, n'iri ry'ivyo ukwizera. Uwandikiye Abaheburayo, yaribukije muri ico gice ca 11 ivy'ababaye abahizi mu kwizera naho atashoboye kudondora inkuru z'umwumwe wese. Ababaye abahizi mu kwizera ni benshi nk'uko tubibona mw'isezerano rya kera. Eka n'abo mw'isezerano risha ntawobaharura, mbere n'uno musi abahizi mu kwizera ni benshi naho batamenyekana. Mbega ni bangahe birirwa barahamwa mbere bakicwa bahorwa izina ry'Umwami Yesu?Ni benshi ntawobaharura.
name: Ivy'abahizi mu Kwizera

description: Twihweje ingene isi yabonye Imana muri Kristo n'ingene uwo Kristo aruta abamalayika . Ivyo vyose twabiganiriyeko twisunze ivyanditswe mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo igice ca 1:3-7.
name: Ivy'icubahiro ca Kristo

description: Tugize iminsi twigishanya kuvyerekeye icubahiro gihambaye ca Kristo. Tukaba twarabonye ingene aruta abavugishwa bose bamutanguriye n'ingene aruta abamalayika. Ubuheruka twarihweje ingene Imana ishingira intahe Kristo ko ariwe mwana wayo w'ikinege . Uwo nyene niwe Imana yatanze ngo apfe kubw' ivyaha vy'abo mw'isi.Mu gice ca 2:1-4 naho twarumvise ko tudakwiye kwanjanjwa ku gakiza kabonerwa muri Kristo Yesu.
name: Ivy'icubahiro gihambaye ca Kristo

description: Twumvise ingene uwo Kristo arengeye n'abamarayika. Uwo niwe Mwami w'abami yahawe kuganza isi izobaho ariko abamalayika nabo n'abakozi gusa.
name: Ivy'icubahiro gikomeye ca Kristo

description: Twashishikaye kwiga kuvy'icubahiro ca Kristo n'ibihambaye yakoze mu gupfa akazuka . Twarumvise kandi uko Kristo yigize umuntu kugira ngo acungure isi. Bitayeko twaribukijwe yuko ukumwizera arikwo kwatumye tuba abana b'Imana maze tugaca twitwa bene se ba Yesu.
name: Ivy'ukwezwa

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'ukwizera kwa Isaka, Yakobo, Yosefu, Mose na Yosuwa, abo bose babaye abahizi mu kwizera umwe wese mubi mwerekeye.
name: Ivy'ukwizera kwa Isaka

description: Twaribukanije ivy'ukwizera kwa Abeli na Henoki duca dushishikara kwiga ivy'ukwizera kwa Nowa. Nowa yabayeho mu gihe abantu bari buzuye ubugarariji bwinshi maze Imana imubwira ko igiye kubaradura, imwereka n'ingene yo kwihisha ngo ntaranduranwe nabo kuko we yari umugororotsi. Imana yamubwiye kubaza ubwato ngo aze abwinjiremwo n'ab'inzu yiwe abandi bose barandurwe numwuzure w'amazi . Kubera ukwizera kwiwe, yaciye abikora nk'uko Imana ibivuze nubwo wamengo ntafatiro bifise. Twarumvise k' abo mu nzu yiwe bose bemeye kwinjira mu bwato bwiwe kuko bari basanzwe bazi ko ar'umuntu yubaha Imana afise amabanga menshi yayo. Natwe dukwiye kubaho mu kwizera no gutinya Imana kandi tukaba ubumote bwiza mubo tubana ndetse no mubo tugendana bose.
name: Ivy'ukwizera kwa Nowa

description: Twigishijwe kuvy'ukwizera kwa Rahabu, uwari maraya w'I Yeriko, uwo niwe yemeye guhisha abatasi b'Abisirayeli bimirije gutera ico gisagara. Rahabu yari yizeye ko Imana izobakorera ibitangaza bagafata ico gisagara kuko yarazi ko irikumwe nabo kuva na kera nari ndi. Uwandikiye Abaheburayo aravuga yuko ataronka umwanya wo kundondora ivy'abahizi mu kwizera batandukanye nka Gideyoni, Baraki, Samusoni, Yefuta,Dawidi , Samweli n'abandi bavugishwa n'Imana.
name: Ivy'ukwizera kwa Rahabu

description: Ijambo nyamukuru twizeko, n'iri ry'ivy'ukwiyambura ibituremera vyose vyotubuza kubandanya uru rugendo rwo kuja mw'ijuru rumeze nk'ihiganwa ry'abasiganwa na cane cane rero dutegerezwa kwiyambura icaha gikunda kutwizingirako vuba.
name: Ivyizigiro

description: Twabonye ivy'icubahiro gihambaye ca Kristo nk'uko twabibonye mu mirongo itatu yambere yo muri ik'icete candikiwe Abaheburayo
name: Kristo n'agaheta

description: Twibukijwe ko Umwami Yesu Kristo atari umuherezi gusa . Yatanguye kuza mw'isi ari nk'umuvugishwa , arapfa , arazuka maze aba umuherezi. Tukaba turindiriye igihe ciwe kizoza aho azoba umwami w'amahanga yose.
name: Kristo n'umuherezi wacu mukuru aruta Aroni

description: Twize ku gikorwa c'ubuherezi c'umwami wacu Yesu Kristo, twarabonye ko ariwe muherezi wacu mukuru aruta Abalewi. Igicaniro yadutangiweko ni ku musaraba I Gologota aho yapfa azira ivyaha vy'abari mw'isi bose. Satani we yagomba ko yesu yopfa mu bundi buryo butari ubwo kudupfira ku musaraba, ariko Yesu yaciye asenga ngo Imana imurenganye urwo rupfu ashike nyabuna k' umusaraba nk'uko vyari mu nteguro yo kuducungura , tubibona aha muri ikicete c'Abaheburayo 5:7
name: Kristo niwe muherezi wacu mukuru aruta Abalewi

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'igikangiro c'Imana ku bana bayo. Twaribukijwe ko Imana idukangira kubera ko idukunda, iyo duciye mu ngorane rero ntacotuma duca tubona ko umengo karabaye Imana yo nyene iba izi igituma bishitse kandi ninayo ishobora kudukiza. Nta nakimwe Imana ikora idafise ico ishaka gushikako hari naho iduteza ingorane kugira ngo itwigishe kwihangana kandi turushirizeho kuyizigira maze turushirizeho gutera imbere mu gikorwa cayo muri kazoza. Twarangirije ku mpanuro zerekeye kugiriranira amahoro n'abantu bose n'ukwezwa hamwe no kugira umwete mu rugendo turimwo ruja mw'ijuru ( Abaheburayo 12:15).
name: Kugororokera Imana yatugize abana bayo

description: Twarihweje akaga kava ku kutizera. Ijambo ry'Imana riravuga yuko umutima utizera ar'umutima mubi. Heb 3:13, umutima mubi utizera utera kureka Imana. Dutegerezwa guhanurana ubudahengeshanya twisunze ijambo ry'Imana, ijambo ry'Imana niryo rifasha abantu kwitandukanya n'ivyaha .Heb 3:13 Imana kuva na kera yamye ibabazwa n'uko abantu bayo bagira imitima ikomantaye ituma batitaho kwubahiriza ico ijambo ryayo rivuga. Uwandikiye Abalewi yarabivuze: Abarewi 3:15. Ayo n'amajambo akomye ku Balewi no kuri twebwe twumva ijambo ry'Imana uyu musi.
name: Ntitugire umutima mubi w'ukutizera

description: Twihweje ingene ikimazi Kristo yatanze kiruta ibimazi vyose vya Mose n'ingene dukwiye kwegera Imana ata bwoba kuko Kristo yaduciriye inzira aho yapfa ku musaraba. Twarumvise kandi amajambo y'imburi kuri abo bose bakora ivyaha ibigira nkana twongera turumva impanuro zerekeye kwihanganira ibitugerageza tubangirije ivyizigiro vyacu vy'ubugingo budashira. Kubaho rero ufise ivyizigiro nivyo bitanga amahoro nyakuri (Abaheburayo 11:38)
name: Ntitwiyonjorora

description: Twihweje ibintu bine bikuru bikuru dusanga mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo igice c'I 10. Ubwa mbere, twaranonosoye imirongo yo muri ico gice itwereka ingene ikimazi Kristo yatanze kiruta ibimazi vya Mose. Twarumvise yuko abaherezi bo mw'isezerano rya kera abo bo muvyagezwe vya Mose, bama bahereza ibimazi vy'ivyaha ubudahengeshanya kugira ngo ivyo vyaha bitwikirwe kugira ngo uburake bw'Imana buhwame. Ivyo bimazi rero vyaguma bitangwa kuko ivyaha bitahanagugwa. Ubwa kabiri, twarabonye ingene Kristo yakuyeho ivya mbere agashinga ivya kabiri nk'uko Imana yabigomvye. ni ukuvuga ko urupfu rwiwe rwabaye ikimazi gikuraho ivyaha, ico nico kimazi caje kiruta ivyatanzwe kera vyose mbere catanzwe rimwe gusa. Abizeye ivy'urwo rupfu rwiwe bakamwakira mu bugingo bwabo nk'umukiza yabahaye ububasha bwo gucika abana b'Imana ariko nta kindi kimazi cari bwatume umuntu ahinduka ng' agire umutima musha. Ico kimazi kimwe gusa nico cabishikije (nk'uko tubibona Abaheburayo 10:14).Ubwa gatatu, twaraganiriye ku majambo y'indemeshanyo kuri abo bose bagiriwe ubuntu bwo gucika abana b'Imana.Abo basabwa kwegera Imana ata bwoba bizeye ata mazinda, kugumya ukwatura ivyizigiro vyabo mu gushikama mu kwizera hamwe no kugwana, ishaka ry'ugukundana hamwe no gukora ibikorwa vyiza vyose. Ubwa kane, twaganiriye ku majambo y'imburi kubakora ivyaha ibigirankana bari baramaze guhabwa kumenya ukuri, kuri abo ntihaba hagisigaye ikimazi c'ivyaha atari ugucirigwako iteka. Twaraganiriye rero twihweza ingene abakristo b'Abaheburayo bibukijweko bihanganiye vyinshi none impera yabo idakwiye gupfa mu magodoka.
name: Twegereze ata bwoba

description: Twabandanije kwihweza ivy'ubuherezi buhambaye b'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo. Uwo niwe muherezi mukuru w'abamwizera bose bemeye kwakira agakiza kabonerwa muri we. Kristo n'umuherezi mukuru aruta abaherezi bose bo mw'isezerano rya kera bahora bahereza ibimazi vy' ivyaha vy'abantu kugira ngo bitwikirirwe. Ariko Kristo we , amaze gutangwa kw'ikimazi c'ivyaha vy'abo mw'isi , abamwakiriye bose yabahaye ububasha bwo gucika abana b'Imana (Yoh 1:12).
name: Ubuherezi bukuru bw'Umwami wacu Yesyu Kristo

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukw'amaraso ya Kristo afise ububasha bwo kwoza ivyaha. Twaribukanije ingene ugupfa kwa Yesu kwatumye abantu baronka uburenganzira bwo kwishikira imbere y'Imana gusenga. Imbere yuko Yesu aza ngo apfe ,abaherezi nibo baserukira abantu ku Mana mu kubatangira ibimazi mw'ihema ryayo. Abaherezi bo mw'isi batangira abantu amaraso y'impene n'amapfizi atashobora guma abahinduka ngo bave mu vyaha ariko Umwami Yesu we yatanze amaraso yiwe yisezerano rishasha ku musaraba. Umwami Yesu rero niwe yitanze nk'ikimazi gishobora gukuraho ivyaha.
name: Ubuherezi bukuru bw'umwami Yesu

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene ubuherezi bwa Kristo buruta ubw'Abayuda. Ubuherezi bwiwe n'ubw'ibihe bidashira ariko Abarewi bo bari abantu bapfa . Kubera ko urupfu rutabakundira kwamaho , n'ubuherezi bw'abo ntibwashobora kwamaho. Ikindi twabonye n'uko ubuherezi bw'Abarewi butashobora gutuma abantu bahinduka ngo bave mu vyaha , ivyaha vyarakogwa ,ibimazi navyo bigashishikara gutangwa kugira ngo ivyo vyaha bitwikirwe. Ariko ubuherezi bw'Umwami wacu Yesu uwadupfiriye butuma imitima yacu iguma mu buntu bw'Imana itinya icaha . Umwami Yesu afise ubuherezi budakurwaho kuko yamaho ibihe bidashira. (Abaheburayo 7:25) Ubuherezi bukuru n'ubw'uwo nyene yamaho. N'uyu musi ni muzima kandi abandanya gukiza . Umwami Yesu Kristo niwe muherezi akwiye kuko ari umugororotsi (Abah 7:26).
name: Ubuherezi bwa Yesu buruta ubw'Abayuda

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvy'urugendo ruja mw'ijuru n'ivyo dutegerezwa kwihanganira kuko urwo rugendo ari nk'ihiganwa abakristo barimwo. Twarumvise mu ntango y'igice ca 12 muri ico cete c'Abaheburayo ko dutegerezwa kwiyambura ibituremera vyotubuza kubandanya guhiganwa neza kandi ngo twiyambure icaha gikunda kutwizingirako vuba.Mu kiganiro giheruka naho, twashimikiye ku kwihanganira imibabaro yose ishobora kudushikira kubera ukwizera kwacu twarumvise ko hari imibabaro ducamwo ivuye ku bigabitanyo vyacu. Mbega none iyo mibabaro yotuma twirata iki? Ariko ngo hari imibabaro idushikira kubera twemeye guhagararira ukuri kw'ijambo ry'Imana aho rero tuba duhiriwe. Twarumvise kandi hari ivy'Imana iducishamwo nk'igikangiro cayo ngo twikebuke mu ngendo zacu, ivyo navyo Imana ibidukorera kuko idukunda kukaba nkako turi abana bayo.Ni ahacu rero kuyumvira no kuyubaha tumenya ko ari ubuntu twagiriwe bwo kubana n'Imana no kwitwa abana bayo.
name: Ukwihanganira ugutozwa indero nziza.

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukwizera ico arico, dufatiye kuvyanditswe mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo igice ca 11:1-3, ico gice ca 11 turibuka ko kivuga kuvyo kwizera gusa. Ku murongo wa 1 twarumvise ico arico kwizera. Twarabonye ko ukwizera aribwo buryo bwonyene bwoshikana abantu ku Mana, kandi ukwizera n'ugutahura kwo mu mpwemu kurengeye rero ugutahura gushimikiye ku kwumva canke ku kubona. Ukwizera kw'ukuri rero ni ugushimikiye kw'ijambo ry'Imana( Abaheburayo 11:2)
name: Ukwizera

description: Twihwereje hamwe ijambo ryo kwizera dufatiye kuri Abeli na Henoki. Ivy'ukwizera kwabo turabisoma mu gitabo c'Itanguriro, mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo naho ivy'abo babiri turabisanga mu gice ca 11: 4 - 5 . Ku vy'Abeli twarumvise ko ikimazi ciwe cemewe n'Imana kubera ko yagize ukwizera akagitanga nk'uko Imana igomba. Ikimazi c'umwagazi w'intama nico Imana yagomba kuko cari igitutu c'ingene hazoza Kristo umwagazi w'intama w'Imana nzima. Birumvikana ko Imana yari yarahishuriye Abeli na Kayini ingene bazohora bayihereza ibimazi, ariko rero Kayini ntiyagomvye kuyihereza umwagazi yashimye gutanga ku vyimbugwa ivyo yari yarabiriye akuya. Kayini rero ntiyashize imbere ukwizera, yashize imbere ibikorwa vyiwe .Twaribukijwe ko n'uyu musi atawokizwa n'ibikorwa vyiwe ariko ko ari ukwizera gutuma umuntu akizwa. Henoki nawe twarumvise ko yagendanye n'Imana akayihimbara , igahava imutwara atabanje guca mu rupfu.
name: Ukwizera kw'Abeli na Henoki

description: Twumvise ivy'ukwizera dufatiye ku karorero k'Aburahamu. Ukwizera n'ukumenya gose ivyizigirwa, udakekeranya ngo ntibizoba kandi ibitabonwa niko kubitumenyesha ko ar'ivy'ukuri( Hebr 11:1 ). Aburahamu ntiyakekeranije igihe Imana imubwiriye kuva mub'iwabo ngo aje kuba mu gihugu izomurangira yamenye ko Imana itabesha kandi ko ariyo izi ico imukuriye aho yaramererewe neza.( Hebr 11:8) Yabaye umuhizi akomeye mu kwizera yamenye adakekeranya k'Imana ifise ahantu imujanye naho atari ahazi. Vyari bikenewe yuko Aburahamu ava mub'iwabo nta kindi bari bamumariye atari ukumumenyereza imigenzo yabo y'ugusenga ibigigwamana. Imama rero yagomba yuko Aburahamu asiga abandi bose akazobana n'umugore wiwe Sara maze Imana ikabona kubahezagira. Ntiyaretse kubishitsa kuko yahavuye ibaha umuhugu mu busaza bwabo uwitwa Isaka .Ikindi twokwibukirako ku kwizera guhambaye kw'Aburahamu, ni ca gihe Imana yamubwira gutanga umuhungu wiwe kw'ikimazi maze Aburahamu nawe ntiyahigimanze. Maze Imana imaze kubona ukwizera guhambaye kw'Aburahamu, yaciye inyaruka igihe kigeze uwo muhugu atarapfa. Isaka Imana ntiyashimye yuko apfa maze akomeza kubana na se na nyina. Wari umuryango uriko imihezagiro y'Imana.
name: Ukwizera Kw'Aburahamu

description: Twumvise ingene umuherezi Melekisedeki yagereranijwe n' Umwami Yesu . Imana irashinga intahe ko Melekisedeki yari umuherezi wayo , Ikongera ikavuga yuko Kristo nawe ari umuherezi w'ibihe bidashira, mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki
name: Yesu n'umuherezi mukuru mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki
